plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence — Option 1 published on catalog pp. 196-197 of the official 2024-2025 catalog; AA-T in Economics. Option 1 takes MATH 50 in Summer before MATH 3A; in the 2024-2025 catalog MATH 3A and ECON 2 moved from Summer to Fall Y2 (Summer is now MATH 50 only; Fall Y2 lists MATH 3A, ECON 2, GEOG 1, CIS 1, POSCI 1/26 and its printed total of 18 now matches the listed courses). 'Prereq for MATH 3A' rows map to major (major preparation); 'US History'/'US/CA Politics' map to core. ECON 1/ECON 2 list only developmental-math prerequisites (MATH 203/211D/230), assumed satisfied at entry by placement — not coded; ECON 1 is explicitly not a prerequisite for ECON 2. BUS 1B's prerequisite (BUS 1A) is coded on the Spring Y2 BUS 1B/MATH 3B/MATH 3E choice (first-listed option); a student choosing MATH 3B needs MATH 3A instead — documented in choice_note. ECON 6 requires ECON 1 and ECON 2 (coded). ENGL 5 requires ENGL 1A (coded). MATH 3A requires MATH 1 and MATH 50 (coded). The 2023-2024 catalog's Fall-term anomaly (printed total 18 vs 10 listed units) is resolved in 2024-2025: the moved courses make the printed 18 reconcile. Computed total at lower bound is 68. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750); sequence pages visually verified from the PDF. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
